record.passage: Growing up is never easy. As teenagers, we face many changes and challenges. Some days are full of joy, while others seem dark and (1) ______. Last year, I felt very (2) ______ about my future. I did not know what I wanted to do, and I often (3) ______ with my parents about small things. My best friend noticed that I was (4) ______ and asked me to join a school club. At first, I was (5) ______ to try because I was afraid of making mistakes. But she (6) ______ me to give it a try. In the club, we worked on a project to help (7) ______ people in our neighbourhood. We visited them, talked with them, and listened to their stories. This experience (8) ______ my life. I learned that helping others can (9) ______ our own problems. I also learned to (10) ______ my feelings with my family instead of keeping them inside. Now I feel more (11) ______ and confident. I understand that growing up takes time, and that everyone (12) ______ mistakes. When we face difficulties, we should not (13) ______ up. Instead, we should ask for help and keep (14) ______ forward. Looking back, I am (15) ______ for every challenge, because each one has made me stronger.

questions.stem: Some days are full of joy, while others seem dark and (1) ______.
knowledge_points: adjective meaning in context: dark and depressing
questions.explanation: 此处需要与前面的joy形成对比，表示有些日子显得黑暗而忧郁，gloomy意为“忧郁的、阴暗的”，符合语境。bright、cheerful和sunny都表示明亮或愉快，与dark并列时语义矛盾，不能表达消极情绪。本题考查形容词在对比语境中的语义辨析。

questions.stem: Last year, I felt very (2) ______ about my future.
knowledge_points: adjective meaning in context: not knowing what will happen
questions.explanation: 后文说“我不知道自己想做什么”，说明对未来感到不确定，uncertain意为“不确定的”，符合句意。confident、sure和certain都表示有信心或确定，与后文语境相反。本题考查形容词在情感描述中的语义辨析。

questions.stem: I did not know what I wanted to do, and I often (3) ______ with my parents about small things.
knowledge_points: verb meaning in context: to disagree angrily
questions.explanation: 句意是经常因为小事和父母争吵，argue with sb. about sth.意为“就某事与某人争论”，符合语境。agreed意为同意，laughed意为笑，talked with意为交谈，都不能体现因小事产生冲突的语境。本题考查动词短语argue with的搭配与语义。

questions.stem: My best friend noticed that I was (4) ______ and asked me to join a school club.
knowledge_points: adjective meaning in context: sad because alone
questions.explanation: 朋友注意到“我”感到孤独，于是邀请“我”加入社团，lonely意为“孤独的”，符合逻辑。happy、cheerful和sociable都表示积极或善于交际，与需要被邀请加入社团以缓解情绪的背景不符。本题考查形容词在情感描述中的语义辨析。

questions.stem: At first, I was (5) ______ to try because I was afraid of making mistakes.
questions.explanation: because I was afraid of making mistakes说明起初不愿意尝试，reluctant意为“不情愿的”，be reluctant to do表示不愿做某事。eager、willing和keen都表示渴望或愿意，与害怕犯错的语境矛盾。本题考查形容词短语be reluctant to的用法。

questions.stem: But she (6) ______ me to give it a try.
questions.explanation: 朋友鼓励“我”试一试，encourage sb. to do sth.意为“鼓励某人做某事”，符合语境。forced意为强迫，ordered意为命令，allowed意为允许，都不能体现朋友善意鼓励的语气。本题考查动词encourage的搭配与语义。

questions.stem: In the club, we worked on a project to help (7) ______ people in our neighbourhood.
knowledge_points: elderly people = old people needing care
questions.explanation: 正确答案是elderly，因为语境提到在俱乐部帮助邻居中的老人，elderly people意为老年人，符合帮助对象。wealthy意为富有的，与帮助老人的语境不符；famous意为著名的，也不符合；foreign意为外国的，同样不恰当。本题考察形容词词义辨析，需根据上下文选择符合逻辑的词汇。
这次经历改变了“我”的生活，change意为“改变”，与后文“我学到很多”相呼应。ended意为结束，saved意为拯救，wasted意为浪费，都不符合这段经历带来积极转变的语境。本题考查动词在语境中的语义辨析。

questions.stem: I learned that helping others can (9) ______ our own problems.
knowledge_points: ease problems meaning reduce their burden
questions.explanation: 句意是帮助他人可以缓解我们自己的问题，ease意为“减轻、缓解”，符合语境。create意为制造，ignore意为忽视，repeat意为重复，都不能表达减轻问题的意思。本题考查动词ease表示“缓解”的用法。

questions.stem: I also learned to (10) ______ my feelings with my family instead of keeping them inside.
knowledge_points: share feelings meaning express them to others
questions.explanation: instead of keeping them inside说明“我”学会与家人分享感受，share意为“分享”，share sth. with sb.意为“与某人分享某事”。hide意为隐藏，lose意为失去，test意为测试，都与instead of后的对比语义不符。本题考查动词share的搭配与语义。

questions.stem: Now I feel more (11) ______ and confident.
questions.explanation: 正确答案是optimistic，因为与confident并列，表示积极乐观的情绪，符合现在感觉更好的语境。curious意为好奇的，generous意为慷慨的，patient意为耐心的，这些词都不能与confident形成合理的并列，且不符合成长后心态变好的描述。本题考察形容词词义辨析及语境理解。

questions.stem: I understand that growing up takes time, and that everyone (12) ______ mistakes.
questions.explanation: 正确答案是commits，commit mistakes是固定搭配，意为犯错误，符合每个人都会犯错的语境。repeats意为重复，avoids意为避免，corrects意为改正，它们与mistakes搭配时意思分别为重复错误、避免错误、改正错误，都不符合‘每个人都会犯错’这一普遍事实。本题考察动词词义辨析及固定搭配。

questions.stem: When we face difficulties, we should not (13) ______ up.
knowledge_points: give up: stop trying, phrasal verb
questions.explanation: give up是固定短语，意为“放弃”，句意是面对困难时不应放弃。take up意为开始从事，put up意为搭建或张贴，set up意为建立，都不能与up搭配表达“放弃”的意思。本题考查动词短语give up的固定搭配。

questions.stem: Instead, we should ask for help and keep (14) ______ forward.
knowledge_points: move forward: make progress, collocating with keep
questions.explanation: keep moving forward意为“继续向前”，符合面对困难应继续前进的语境。looking forward意为期待，running forward和standing forward都不能与keep搭配表达持续前进的意思。本题考查动词短语keep moving forward的搭配与语义。

questions.stem: Looking back, I am (15) ______ for every challenge, because each one has made me stronger.
knowledge_points: be grateful for: feeling thankful for something
questions.explanation: 句意是“我”感激每一个挑战，因为它们让“我”更坚强，be grateful for意为“对……感激”，符合语境。eager for意为渴望，sorry for意为抱歉，ready for意为准备好，都不能表达对挑战的感激之情。本题考查形容词短语be grateful for的用法。
